about: Multi-turn Tiny Apps tester scenarios for the live smoke harness (module_work/live_smoke/run.py flow). PUBLIC documents only: Review-suite document ids (Mecklenburg County standard details, UFC manuals, the app's sample calc packages, planlens synthetic fixtures), {"file": ...} from geotech-references/docs (FHWA/UFC only), {"sample": ...} from funhouse_agent/eval_samples, {"render": ...} screenshots cut from those, {"doc": <ref>, "name": ...} any of those renamed, {"make": {"kind": ...}} files generated in docs.py (a stamped sheet set C-1..C-10, an invented spec section as PDF or DOCX that contradicts some sheets, a submittal-log XLSX, a DXF plan, a JPEG phone photo, a scan, a sideways sheet, a blank PDF, planlens' synthetic report). Every flow runs as a Tiny Apps user (IIS header identity LIVESMOKE\tester) unless it names another; SharePoint is the local fake library. Step keys: upload | paste (+say) | say | say + together_with ({"as", "say"} or a list: sent at the same moment, in threads; those sessions must have acted before) | new_conversation | open ("previous" or an index) | restart | restore; "as" picks a session. An upload of a type the app's uploader does not take (core.ACCEPTED_UPLOAD_TYPES, e.g. .docx/.xlsx) is refused before the app sees it, as Streamlit refuses it. 'cost' is a rough tier for --max-cost; 'expect' is soft (whether the flow exercised the plumbing it was written for), never a pass/fail.
